{{Quote|Congratulations Chewie, that was about the best zoochberry pie I've ever had.|Luke Skywalker to Chewbacca|<ref name="Lost" />}}
'''Zoochberry pie''' was a type of [[Pie/Legends|pie]] made with [[Zoochberry/Legends|zoochberries]], [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]].<ref name="Lost" /> In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the [[Adventures of a Jedi Prince|''Jedi Prince'']] series, which includes the events of ''[[The Lost City of the Jedi]]'' and ''[[Queen of the Empire]]'', in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> the Human [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] moved into a [[Han Solo's sky house|sky house]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] with his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] companion [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. The Wookiee learned to cook zoochberry pies there and served one to their Human friend [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] for dessert when he visited the sky house. Skywalker complemented Chewbacca's pie as the best he had ever eaten.<ref name="Lost" />

Later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> Solo traveled to [[Hologram Fun World]] to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], where they met their friend [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. After the couple realized that neither of them had their [[birth certificate]]s, Calrissian remarked that, as he was [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of the world, a solution would be "simple as zoochberry pie."<ref name="Queen">''[[Queen of the Empire]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Zoochberry pie first appeared in the [[1992]] junior novel ''[[The Lost City of the Jedi]]'', written by [[Paul Davids|Paul]] and [[Hollace Davids]].<ref name="Lost" />
